description: Draws the contents of the buffer and the position of every Embellish, Ruminate and Fixation head in the group; it runs while touching a group of modules with a Memory or MemoryCV at the left-hand end
notes: it draws nothing until a Memory or MemoryCV is the left-most module of the touching group it is in
the buffer is drawn from its start at the bottom of the screen to its end at the top, which are the 0V and 10V of the position voltages on the other modules
the grey spine is the peak level of the left channel left of the white centre line and of the right channel to its right; the number in the corner is the voltage a full-width line has
a Ruminate head is a line from the left edge, a Fixation head a short line touching neither edge, an Embellish head a line from the right edge, each in the colour of its own module's light
attached to a MemoryCV the screen draws the two CV curves rather than levels, and scales the two channels separately
several of these in one group all draw the same thing
the module has no menu items of its own
